exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) classified as low, within, or excessive according to IOM guidelines
cohort: The study included 1843 women from 7 Belgian hospitals who underwent universal GDM screening with a 75-g oral glucose tolerance test.
finding: Low gestational weight gain in women with gestational diabetes was safe and associated with a better postpartum metabolic profile, while excessive GWG was linked to increased risks of neonatal hypoglycemia in GDM women and higher rates of large-for-gestational age infants and instrumental delivery in NGT women.
mod_finding: NGT women with excessive GWG had a higher rate of instrumental delivery compared to those with GWG within range (aOR 1.53; 95% CI, 1.03-2.27; P =. 035).
